report.finding: The model is fine and the integrator is fine. The steady state is vo/k1 = 1/0.02 = 50, and the approach to it is exponential with time constant 1/k1 = 50 time units. The user simulated only to t=10, i.e. 0.2 of a time constant, so S1 is nowhere near having leveled off - it's still on the initial near-linear rise. Tightening tolerances can't help because the numerics were never the issue.
report.evidence: Re-ran rr.reset() then simulated to t=300: S1 asymptotes to ~49.9, consistent with the analytic steady state vo/k1=50. At t=10 (the user's run) S1=9.06, far from steady state, exactly as expected for an exponential approach with tau=50.

recommended_changes.why: Simulate over several multiples of the 1/k1=50 time-constant (e.g. to t=200-300) to actually observe convergence to the steady state of 50.
